2. Do you want the same behaviour for the Markdown exporter?
3. Which should take priority, fixing the symptom or the root cause?

a) Fix the symptom, or fix the root cause if that is easy
b) Fix the root cause only
c) Both, or just the symptom if the root cause turns out to be risky

I recommend a) or b), depending on how big the change is.
